label: Ovaltine
note: Developed 1904 in Bern by Albert Wander; name from Latin ovum (egg) and malt; malt extract, sugar and whey, some flavours with cocoa

about.text: Malt-based drink powder invented by the Swiss pharmacist Albert Wander in Bern in 1904 and sold as Ovomaltine in Switzerland.
